data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 白色花园的精确誓约
data.description: 【AST 纪念花园·清晨】折纸换下作战装备，穿着线条利落的白色婚纱站在整齐的玫瑰拱门下；她先精准调整头纱角度，再把一朵白玫瑰别到胸前，冰蓝色眼神在看向镜头时罕见地显出柔软。
data.action: 玫瑰拱门下调整头纱并别上白玫瑰，转向镜头时露出罕见柔软微笑
data.lighting: cool morning light with silver dew highlights
data.mood: 克制表情里的温柔誓约
data.promptProse: Origami Tobiichi from Date A Live wears a tailored white bridal gown with a clean short veil, silver fastening and a single white rose. She checks the veil alignment beneath a geometric rose arch before pinning the last white flower to her bodice. The precise ritual finally breaks into a tiny smile when she faces the viewer, her cool blue eyes softened by the morning garden. cool morning light with silver dew highlights.
